title: CHSM8: A Chess Transformer that Follows Natural-Language Style Prompts
abstract: arXiv:2610.25356v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present CHSM8, a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on a free-text description of a playing style, e.g. "go for the Sicilian Defense", "solid, safe, risk-free chess" or "You are Magnus Carlsen in his prime". The model is pretrained without search on 1.07B filtered Lichess games, using a factorized move representation and legal-move masking. It reaches 1837 Elo against a strength-limited Stockfish and, in 1,000-game matches, beat every other public model we tested that was likewise trained without preference tuning, rewards or search, including one with 13 times as many parameters. We then fine-tune it to follow text on a synthetic dataset: Gemma-4-31B describes the playing style of 3M game sides, a 1B Gemma-3 model distilled from the 2.4M of those descriptions that contradict nothing on the board labels the rest, and every one of 30M selected game sides gets five descriptions. translated_title: CHSM8：一种遵循自然语言风格提示的国际象棋Transformer
translated_abstract: 我们提出了CHSM8，一个2.1亿参数的国际象棋Transformer，它可以根据对下棋风格的自由文本描述来走子，例如“采用西西里防御”、“稳健、安全、无风险的棋风”或“你是巅峰时期的马格努斯·卡尔森”。该模型在10.7亿局经过筛选的Lichess对局上进行预训练，无需搜索，采用因式分解的走子表示和合法走子掩码。在面对强度受限的Stockfish时，它达到了1837 Elo的等级分；在1000局的比赛中，它击败了我们测试的所有其他同样在没有偏好调优、奖励或搜索的情况下训练的公开模型，其中包括一个参数量是其13倍的模型。随后，我们在一个合成数据集上对其进行微调以使其遵循文本指令：Gemma-4-31B为300万个对局方描述其下棋风格，一个从240万条与棋盘标签无矛盾的描述中蒸馏而来的1B Gemma-3模型对其余描述进行标注，并且所筛选的3000万个对局方中的每一个都获得五条风格描述。监督微调……
tldr: CHSM8是一个2.1亿参数的国际象棋Transformer，无需搜索即可根据自然语言风格提示下棋，达到1837 Elo并击败了包括参数量为其13倍模型在内的所有同类公开模型，并通过合成数据微调使其能够理解文本风格指令。
en_tdlr: CHSM8 is a 210M-parameter chess transformer that plays moves conditioned on free-text style prompts without search, reaching 1837 Elo and beating all comparable public models—including one with 13 times more parameters—and is further fine-tuned on synthetic data to follow natural-language style descriptions.
